Hi Aisha —

Thanks for taking the call this morning. We need to get CloudVendor set up in our procurement flow so we can issue the initial purchase order and route invoices. To proceed we need the following items from you:

1) Signed DPA (or a DPA we can countersign) — attach as PDF or send DocuSign link
2) Link to your latest SOC 2 report (read-only hosted link is fine) and the auditor/date
3) Current subprocessor inventory (CSV preferred) with versions/dates
4) Remit-to / billing contact and legal entity name for PO (exact line for the PO)
5) Any preferred PO terms that would block issuance (e.g., specific SLA clauses, additional insurances)

Ben — can you confirm the internal billing address and whether we need to route this through our marketplace team for tax? Karthik / Marissa — FYI on the privacy gate.

Target timeline: get DPA and subprocessor list by EOD Thursday (24th) so procurement can create PO next week. If you need an e-sign flow, we can accept DocuSign.

Thanks,
